title: No unified symbolic diagnostic code type
detail: vb_core::DiagnosticCode is purely numeric (u16). No symbolic diagnostic code type exists in the public API. The stable contract exposes E0101-style codes, not DUPLICATE_KEY-style.

title: ValidationError has no code() method
detail: ValidationError uses #[error("DUPLICATE_KEY")] for display but has no method to extract the symbolic code as a typed value. Downstream code must parse display strings.

title: YamlError has no diagnostic code support
detail: YamlError has no code() method and no diagnostic code mapping. All 20 variants are stringly errors.

title: Numeric code range incomplete
detail: is_supported_code() in diagnostic.rs does not include E05xx (gate verifier) or E06xx (contract-discovery) ranges. Also missing codes above 0x401B (e.g., 0x401C-0x4020 used by JournalError).

title: No cross-crate symbolic code registry
detail: Each error type (CompileError, ValidationError, CoreError, JournalError, RuntimeError) independently defines code mappings. No shared enum or registry ensures consistency.

title: diag_codes.rs is test-only
detail: 58 numeric code constants in vb_validate/src/diag_codes.rs are #[cfg(test)] only. Should be promoted to public constants for symbolic code registry.
